verdict.rationale: The evidence shows CockroachDB Cloud uses a metered Request Unit (RU) billing model. RU consumption scales to zero when idle, users can review RU usage, docs explain how to tune RU consumption to balance performance and cost, and a monthly cost estimate is extrapolated from observed workload. This gives some bill predictability, but mostly after a workload is running rather than before committing. Missing for 10: published per-unit prices for compute/RUs, storage and network traffic; a pre-commitment pricing calculator; independent corroboration that bills are predictable.
